name: Ted Budd
stance: Early bipartisan focus on catastrophic AI misuse — AI-enabled biological and chemical weapons — and on federal preparedness and risk assessment for it.

statements.text: With Sen. Markey, introduced bills directing HHS to develop a strategy for public-health preparedness against AI misuse (including biological or chemical weapons) and directing ASPR to assess emergent biosecurity risks from AI advances.
we may face the real prospect of AI-generated threats like biological or chemical weapons.
The federal government must not be caught flat-footed on these threats and should begin to prepare now.

review.note: added October 2026 from budd.senate.gov primary sources; quotes verified verbatim
